item.text:
The fault is in [useDefaultShare.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useDefaultShare.ts:16): the hook exposes `getDefaultShare` but no `isShareAvailable`. The required function should await `getShare(abortSignal, shareId)` and return `!share.isLocked && !share.isVolumeSoftDeleted`. [useShare.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useShare.ts:51) already accepts those arguments in that order.

[FolderContainer.tsx](/app/applications/drive/src/app/containers/FolderContainer.tsx:42) currently accepts a folder route without checking share availability. Whether navigation should call the new function is an open scope question; the stated requirements specify the hook function, but do not explicitly require its use there. Existing [tests](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useDefaultShare.test.tsx:75) cover default-share creation, including one `createVolume` call and loading the resulting ID through `getShareWithKey`.

I recorded the diagnosis in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit source or tests because this run’s specialist instructions limit me to fault localization, so the issue remains unresolved.
